limitations: Specific to unweighted simplex-sum stellohedra; distributional limit not a finite-dimensional identity or a total-variation estimate; bibliographic equivalence risk for weighted Gaussian order-statistics auxiliaries.
scientific_integrity: New theorem is a self-contained self-review analytic result conditional on cited standard Gaussian extreme-value and beta-gamma identities. Finite checks supplement but do not prove the infinite limit. No independent validation has been performed.
title: A Poisson extreme-value law for random widths of simplex-sum stellohedra
